issues.title: Module-level _RESULTS accumulates across calls
issues.whats_wrong: fanout appends into an unbounded process-global results list.
acceptance_criteria: Second call does not include first payloads.

issues.title: All request failures are swallowed
issues.whats_wrong: except Exception: pass swallows partner errors.

issues.title: httpx.get has no timeout
issues.why_it_matters: A hung partner stalls the worker.
acceptance_criteria: Every GET has a finite timeout.

issues.title: shutdown() does not release state or HTTP resources
issues.whats_wrong: shutdown returns immediately and does not clear _RESULTS or cancel in-flight work.
issues.why_it_matters: Deploy looks clean while work is still in flight.
how_to_fix: Drain or cancel in-flight gets in shutdown.
acceptance_criteria: shutdown waits or cancels in-flight work.

issues.title: No URL allowlist (SSRF if URLs are untrusted)
issues.whats_wrong: Any string is fetched; this is SSRF into internal endpoints.
issues.why_it_matters: A poisoned list can hit metadata IPs.
